historical_exact_DC_source.claim: Conditional source-bound DC result only; all failed cases and independent final gates retained

interpretation: The maximum 0.32 A flash injection is an adversarial vertex of the existing aggregate electronics budget, not nominal flash current and not a separate added demand.

All ten adjacent-layer barrel segments for the two retained anchors are retained for every fine-grid case. At the worst flash vertex, fbbf08d3 draws approximately 0.280631 A from the F-side and 0.039369 A from the B-side into In3; bb91164d carries approximately 0.32 A from In3 toward F.
The total source-to-flash drop comparison includes the full changed source and retained supply/return paths. It is not an isolated-trace resistance measurement or a transfer of prior qualification.

The seven other downstream pads include decoupling, flash/DSM bias and LED feeds. Their explicit DC terminal injections remain unenumerated within the aggregate allowance; zero modeled injection does not assert zero physical current. The existing conditional case vertices do not establish an independent physical allocation proof for those unmodeled local demand locations.

The separate local passive bound remains 4.0694215 mA at 3.6 V, -1% resistor tolerance and zero LED forward drop, corresponding to 0.3807415 mV across the 11.593319 mm strip at the assumed material. This is local arithmetic inside the aggregate budget; no extra 0.32 A demand or retained-path guarantee is introduced.
All final thermal, AC, signal-protection/reference, ordinary-route closure, manufacturing and flight gates remain open.
